source.manualTitle: Samsung Top-Load Washer CG71 Family (WA7000A) (WA55CG71, WA55CG75, WA54CG)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Thermistor connectors
steps.body: Check washing and dry heater temperature sensor connectors. Rule out winter freeze.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check washing and dry heater temperature sensor connectors. Rule out winter freeze.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace faulty temperature sensor per active TC code.

steps.title: Replace thermistor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace washing or dry temperature sensor as indicated by TC1–TC4.
